identityReview: Chinese founder of Yangshengtang and Nongfu Spring, Zhong Shanshan / 钟睒睒 / 鍾睒睒. Birth year 1954 explicitly supported by contemporaneous The Paper biography; exact day and month not asserted. Keep his company roles distinct from his son Zhong Shu Zi and from adjacent annual-report biographies.
lifeStatusEvidence: Yongpai / China Ningbo Net records his actual meeting with Ningbo city leaders and attendance at the investment-agreement signing on 23 October 2026. It identifies him as chairman; this is a dated report of an event, not a future schedule or an inference from a blank death field.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read relevant sections of two 2025 annual reports, the May 2026 company appointments PDF, two full contemporaneous The Paper articles, the Ningbo meeting report and Zhejiang English biography. Consumer Council primary statement was accessible only as a substantive indexed excerpt.
corrections: Read Nongfu Spring 2025 annual report company profile, listing date and printed page 70 biography. Yangshengtang founded March 1993, predecessor beverage company September 1996; Nongfu chair and executive director from June 2001, general manager from May 2005. H-share trading began 8 September 2020. Wantai chairmanship ran November 2001 to January 2021. Do not derive a birthday from age 71 or transfer adjacent directors’ education to Zhong. Former nomination-committee role is not repeated as current.

Read Wantai Biological 2025 annual report business segments and printed page 122 actual-controller table. It identifies Zhong as a Chinese national and actual controller and corroborates the past chairmanship. Control does not mean sole ownership, current chairmanship or personal invention of vaccines. Diagnostic and vaccine businesses are company activities.

Read The Paper report dated 11 March 2024, which explicitly gives birth year 1954. Keep year precision because a full birth date was not corroborated. The February 27 legal-representative change concerns a subsidiary, not his resignation as chairman of Nongfu Spring. Its Visual China photo lacks verified reuse permission.

Read the company AGM and appointments announcement dated 19 May 2026, hosted by AASTOCKS, especially pages 6–8. Zhong was elected executive director and appointed chairman of the ninth board and general manager effective that date. Future three-year terms are not described as completed. Later October meeting independently supports continued role.

Read The Paper report by Wu Yuxin dated 18 July 2024. It records the Consumer Council’s clarification after a 17 July meeting: reclassification of the tested sample as natural drinking water, rating raised from 4.5 to 5 stars and apology for misunderstanding. The result applies to the sample; it is not permanent certification of all products or evidence of personal criminal liability.

Read the substantive indexed excerpt of the Consumer Council clarification, corroborating sample classification, rating and apology. Opening the primary URL returned navigation and footer without the statement body. Do not claim a full-page primary-source read; the full readable contemporaneous account is source s5.

Read Yongpai / Ningbo report dated 23 October 2026, identifying an actual meeting with Wang Cheng and Shen Mingquan and Zhong as Yangshengtang and Nongfu Spring chairman. They witnessed the Meishanyuan beverage-production-base investment agreement. This records signing, not construction completion, production start or a verified investment amount.

Read Zhejiang government English portal / China Daily biography dated 12 January 2021: journalism at Zhejiang Daily preceded business. Historical wealth and market-share figures are not carried forward as current. The portrait caption says provided to China Daily, which does not establish an open reuse license.
sourceReview.limits: Consumer Council primary-page body was not returned by direct opening; full readable contemporaneous coverage supplies the clarification details. No exact birthday independently established. No openly licensed portrait original selected or inspected. Company transactions and governance are not treated as personal inventions or sole ownership.

portraitReview.unresolved: Bounded English and Chinese Commons, Creative Commons and Flickr searches did not establish an eligible openly licensed portrait. The government-portal photo is credited only as provided to China Daily; The Paper credits Visual China. Neither establishes reuse permission. No original was selected, downloaded or visually inspected. Source chain, identity, colour and crop remain to be verified after an authorized image is found.

translationReview.scope: 32 display fields in each of seven foreign languages checked against Chinese and the English reference. Preserve current Nongfu roles versus former Wantai chairmanship and continuing control, year-only birth precision, sample-specific testing clarification and project signing versus construction completion or production start.
